exports.behavior: Rejects lengths above 64 with InvalidToken, Scanner, offset zero before copying; otherwise copies exactly the input into a zero-initialized 64-byte array.

Locally classifies quotes, backslashes, six punctuation classes, JSON whitespace, controls, ASCII digits, and non-ASCII bytes in address order. Always reports Scalar and never calls classify, quotes, or structural.

unsafe_justifications: No unsafe code is introduced in production or tests. Slice copying is bounded by an explicit length check, and mask shifts use positions from a fixed 64-byte array.
Production code uses no allocation, architecture intrinsics, or additional dependencies; both exports remain available on no_std, arm32, and other non-AArch64 targets.

test_vectors.name: load_every_length_at_every_lane_alignment
test_vectors.coverage: All lengths 0 through 64 at all 16 lane-relative offsets; copied prefixes, zero suffixes, and unchanged source storage.

test_vectors.name: loaded_block_owns_its_bytes_and_zero_padding
test_vectors.coverage: Source mutation after loading leaves the returned block and padding unchanged.

test_vectors.name: oversized_inputs_are_rejected_without_length_truncation
test_vectors.coverage: Every input length 65 through 1024; complete error metadata and unchanged input.

test_vectors.name: exact_mixed_vector_includes_every_raw_class
test_vectors.coverage: Literal masks for every class, including whitespace/control overlap, DEL exclusion, and high-byte membership.

test_vectors.name: every_byte_at_every_position_matches_membership_oracle
test_vectors.coverage: All 256 byte values at each of 64 positions, plus all 256 uniform blocks, compared with an independent membership oracle.

test_vectors.name: lane_edges_and_bit_63_keep_byte_order
test_vectors.coverage: Positions 0, 15, 16, 31, 32, 47, 48, and 63 produce 0x8001800180018001; alternating digits and high bytes produce complementary full-width masks.

test_vectors.name: selected_raw_and_structural_paths_match_scalar_on_all_hosts
test_vectors.coverage: 256 deterministic byte permutations at each of 16 offsets compare scalar, selected raw, and structural results, including actual-path backend tags.

test_vectors.name: non_aarch64_always_selects_scalar
test_vectors.coverage: Cfg-gated non-AArch64 assertions for unsupported NEON detection and scalar raw and ABI backend tags.

test_vectors.name: every_tail_length_and_initial_quote_state_matches_oracle
test_vectors.coverage: Rotating mixed-byte vectors at every valid length and all four canonical quote carry states compare the canonical ClassifyFn, forced scalar pipeline, and full-block entry point against an independent byte-state oracle.

test_vectors.name: exact_partial_vectors_preserve_raw_classes_and_filter_string_punctuation
test_vectors.coverage: Literal ABI masks for an object containing a colon inside a string and for a string containing an escaped quote; verifies raw punctuation survives while structural punctuation excludes string content.

test_vectors.name: padding_neither_emits_controls_nor_consumes_trailing_escape
test_vectors.coverage: Every tail length and incoming state verifies zero padding appears only in raw control masks, never observable control masks or carry transitions.

test_vectors.name: every_split_preserves_masks_and_carry_across_empty_and_partial_blocks
test_vectors.coverage: All split positions 0 through 64 with backslash runs at lane boundaries and all canonical incoming states reconstruct all 15 ABI masks and final carry.

test_vectors.name: long_backslash_runs_cross_multiple_full_blocks
test_vectors.coverage: Three consecutive 64-byte backslash blocks followed by an escape-sensitive partial tail.

test_vectors.name: empty_input_and_all_utf8_tail_lengths_preserve_opaque_state
test_vectors.coverage: Every u8 UTF-8 tail length and every canonical quote state; empty Scalar results and preservation of opaque UTF-8 bytes across nonempty classification.

test_vectors.name: integration_errors_are_transactional_and_length_takes_precedence
test_vectors.coverage: Noncanonical quote fields, high-bit carry values, empty and full blocks, oversized lengths including 256 and 257, exact error metadata, unchanged carry, and length-error precedence.
